## Project

Folder and the path the notebook reads.

## Problem

Wrong file, missing file, ambiguous name, or a file that should not be public.

## Source

Public location of the correct table, if you know it. Do not attach private data.

## Proposed fix

Rename, replace, remove, or document. If the file cannot be committed, give the filename the notebook should expect.
